C1.worst_defect: The hero says what it is and who it is for, but the default path is the hosted till at app.vendurepos.com, and nothing above the fold (or anywhere) says what that costs, who runs it or whether it stays free. A buyer used to Square or Shopify POS pricing pages is left guessing.
C1.where: home.desktop.01 hero; home.txt 'Live demo / Quick start'

C2.worst_defect: 'MIT licensed' sits in the footer and the hero, yet 'To build and host it yourself ... you need your own RxDB Premium licence token' never says that is a paid third-party licence. No maintainer, company or support channel is named anywhere, and the demo's analytics go to an unexplained 'ph.wcpos.com'. The real choice is a hosted app with no stated operator or terms, or a self-build that has a hidden licence cost. There is also no 'who should not use this / vs Shopify POS, Square' section.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 'Setting up the store' last bullet + footer; limitations.txt 'Setting up the store'; connect-a-till.txt 'Where requests go'

C3.worst_defect: The role the plugin's own 'New POS till key' button creates is missing ReadOrder in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0, so the till's order history is refused. The site documents this workaround in four places (quick-start step 4 and Optional, connect-a-till twice, changelog 'Not in the release notes') instead of shipping a fix, and the last plugin release was 2026-10-06. The collapsed 'If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app' also hints at a domain move that is never explained.
C3.where: quick-start.txt 'Optional: a device key for each till'; changelog.desktop.01 0.2.0 last bullet; quick-start.desktop.03 collapsed row

C4.worst_defect: The changelog is written as internal protocol notes ('GET /tally/v1/info advertises order.create 1–5 (ADR 0005)', 'maxShippingLines: 1 and lineTax: { none: true, classes: true }'), with 'ADR 0005' repeated four times in one release. Only the 'In short' lines tell a store owner what changed for them.

C5.worst_defect: Below the two boxed proof cards, the eight remaining 'What it does today' features are unboxed title+paragraph pairs in a dense two-column grid. The section's weight drops abruptly, and the Live demo / Quick start CTA pair is repeated a second time at the bottom.

C6.worst_defect: The phone header shows only 'Docs' and 'Live demo', so Quick start sits behind the chevron. On the docs side the Quick start page runs to 10,580 px, and without a sticky 'step n of 9' marker beyond the collapsed 'On this page' bar it is easy to lose your place.
C6.where: home.phone.01 header; quick-start.phone.01 '1. Install the plugin' dropdown; tech.json quick-start.phone height 10580

C7.worst_defect: The SoftwareApplication JSON-LD has no softwareVersion or offers/price, although the page itself states 'plugin 0.3.0' and the price question is exactly what a buyer's search snippet would want. Mobile LCP is 2.3–2.5 s, with 53 KiB of unused JS flagged.

overall_worst.defect: The site sells 'open-source, MIT licensed', but in practice you either use app.vendurepos.com, with no stated operator, price, terms or longevity, or self-build with an 'RxDB Premium licence token' that it never says is a paid commercial licence. No person or company stands behind the project anywhere on the site, so I could not tell a client who they would be depending on.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 'Setting up the store' + footer; limitations.txt; connect-a-till.txt 'Where your data goes'
overall_worst.fix: Add two plain lines to 'Before you start' and Limitations: who runs app.vendurepos.com and on what terms (free, no SLA, etc.), and that RxDB Premium is a paid licence from a third party with a link to its price. Name the maintainer or company in the footer.
